title: Dancing Tokens on the Vocabulary Network from LLM Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18248v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate text one token at a time, yet how a particular generation relates to the geometry learned in pre-training remains unclear. The fundamental explainability of LLMs is elusive. Here, we build a similarity network from the input embeddings of six open LLMs and map generation onto it. The token-embedding network is scale-free while heavy-tailed, as are random embeddings with matched covariance, but far more fragmented. Distillation barely changes this topology because input embeddings are largely inherited. The knowledge space is thus deterministic from pre-training. Consecutive generated tokens are rarely graph neighbours and, in most models, no more often than in shuffled order, so generation is not a walk on the predefined network, although the tokens it visits are concentrated within it. translated_title: LLM生成过程中词汇网络上起舞的标记
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）逐个标记（token）地生成文本，但特定的生成过程与预训练中学习到的几何结构之间的关系仍不清楚，LLM的根本可解释性依然难以捉摸。在此，我们基于六个开源LLM的输入嵌入构建了一个相似性网络，并将生成过程映射到该网络上。该标记嵌入网络是无标度且呈重尾分布的，这与协方差匹配的随机嵌入类似，但其碎片化程度要高得多。蒸馏几乎不改变这种拓扑结构，因为输入嵌入在很大程度上是被继承的，因此知识空间在预训练阶段即已确定。连续生成的标记很少是图上的邻居，且在大多数模型中，其相邻出现频率并不比乱序排列时更高，因此生成过程并非在预定义网络上的游走，尽管它所访问的标记都集中于该网络内部。通过逐层的logit lens分析发现，在大多数模型中，标记在网络较深处才趋于稳定，而具有重复生成倾向的模型……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过构建LLM词表嵌入的相似性网络，揭示知识空间的碎片化拓扑在预训练阶段即已确定（蒸馏几乎不改变它），且文本生成并非沿该网络的游走，而是集中访问网络内部、并在网络深处才最终确定的动态过程。
en_tdlr: This study builds similarity networks from LLM input embeddings, revealing that the fragmented knowledge-space topology is determined during pre-training (distillation barely changes it), and that text generation is not a walk on this predefined network but concentrates within it, with tokens settling late in depth.
